images.subject: Far away on the horizon, on top of a towering sea cliff, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: Beyond the ridge, towering dark neutral grey rock cliffs plunge straight into a vast dark slate-grey sea with heavy swell and white surf, which stretches to the horizon, on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock and sea.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are the dark sea and plain dark rocky shore sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.subject: Far away on the horizon, at the foot of a huge flat-topped mesa, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: The vast plain is dotted with tall flat-topped mesas and slender buttes of layered neutral grey and pale ochre rock with sheer striped walls, stretching to distant mountains, on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are plain bare dark rocky plain sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.subject: Far away on the horizon, in a clearing at the foot of a towering cliff, stands a small cluster of far-future high-tech installations with domes and towers, tiny in the frame, their windows and floodlights glowing brightly.
images.site: The valley is covered by a dense alien jungle of giant strange plants with huge broad dark teal leaves, twisted trunks and glowing pale blossoms, rising in layers toward distant mist-covered mountains, on a humid alien planet.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are the dark canopy of the jungle sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.
